name: Thabo Cele
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. Originally a chef at a prestigious Durban hotel, he was headhunted to cater a private event for a racing team owner. His meticulous attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality meals under pressure impressed the owner, leading to an offer he couldn't refuse. 

Now, as catering manager for Nostalgia Racing, Thabo prides himself on providing nutritious and delicious meals that fuel the team's performance. He believes that a well-fed crew is a happy and efficient crew. He's known for his innovative menu designs, incorporating local South African flavors with performance-enhancing ingredients, and his unflappable demeanor, even when faced with the most demanding dietary requirements.

physical.description: Thabo is a powerfully built man with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Always carries a small notebook filled with menu ideas and nutritional information.
Unintentionally uses racing terminology when discussing food prep, e.g., 'We need to streamline this sauce reduction process!'
